experiment: E13: views rendered as diagrams and exported to SVG in CATIA Magic (tools/cameo-scripts/exportViewDiagrams.groovy)
setup: Libraries and examples 01-05 loaded; the 9 views of examples/05-OnlineStoreViews.sysml requested; a bounded undo removes only the commands of this run

predictions.claim: No view has a diagram before the run (E07: loading and evaluating views creates none)
Diagrams.createDiagram(view, Diagrams.getViewDefinition(view), false) creates a diagram for every view without an exception, inside the session
The whole run leaves exactly one undoable command named 'UML3 View Diagrams' on top of the history
DisplayExposedElements shows at least the elements of each view's recorded 'includes' (tests/cameo/view-predictions.json) and none of its 'excludes' as shapes
ImageExporter.export(diagram, SVG, file) writes a non-empty SVG for every view, and each 'includes' name occurs as text in the SVG
Undoing the 'UML3 View Diagrams' command removes the diagrams: afterwards Diagrams.getDiagram(view) is null again
